design:
New file src/navegador.js (ESM, plain JS, like tarefas.js: takes injected deps so main.js stays the owner of state). Exports iniciaNavegador(deps) returning { navegadorFecha, ferramentasNavegador, registraIpc }.

Pane (per window, lazily created, stored in j.nav):
- navegadorGarante(j): new WebContentsView({ webPreferences: { partition: "persist:preview", sandbox: true, contextIsolation: true, nodeIntegration: false } }); j.win.contentView.addChildView(view); view.setVisible(false) until the renderer reports a rect.
- Session hardening once: session.fromPartition("persist:preview").setPermissionRequestHandler((_,__,cb)=>cb(false)); view.webContents 'will-navigate' and 'will-redirect' reject any scheme except http/https; setWindowOpenHandler loads the URL in the same view and returns deny.
- Events on view.webContents (did-navigate, did-navigate-in-page, page-title-updated, did-start-loading, did-stop-loading, did-fail-load) feed navegadorEstado(j) -> enviarEvento(j, {tipo:'nav_estado', url, titulo, voltar: wc.navigationHistory.canGoBack(), avancar: canGoForward(), carregando}).
- IPC (ipcMain.handle, J(e) like the others): nav_abrir(url) (normalizes: bare host becomes https://, localhost/127.0.0.1/[::1] becomes http://; person-typed, no approval), nav_acao(voltar|avancar|recarregar) via wc.navigationHistory.goBack/goForward/reload, nav_area(rect|null) which does view.setBounds(rounded rect) + setVisible(!!rect), nav_estado.
- Renderer src/renderer/navegador.js: aside.navegador in grid column 4 (body.nav-aberto sets --nav: 520px), toolbar with back/forward/reload buttons, URL input (Enter calls vivo.navAbrir), a servers dropdown, and a placeholder div.nav-tela. A ResizeObserver plus window resize send getBoundingClientRect to vivo.navArea; closing the pane or opening a modal overlay sends navArea(null) to hide the native view. Toggle button before #infoBtn (pattern of botaoTerm in terminal.js) and shortcut Ctrl+Shift+B in interface.js keymap. The pane is docked, not a floating janelinha, because native views draw above DOM.

MCP tools (added to servidorTemasPara via ...ferramentasNavegador(t), each { alwaysLoad: true }, zod schemas):
- browser_navigate({url}): garanteSite(t, url), then wc.loadURL and wait for did-stop-loading (15 s cap); opens the pane (enviarEvento 'nav_mostrar').
- browser_screenshot(): wc.capturePage() -> toPNG -> ajustaImagem(base64,'image/png') (main.js:241) -> { content:[{type:'image', data, mimeType}] }.
- browser_read({seletor?}): wc.executeJavaScript on document.body.innerText (cap 20000 chars) plus the URL and title; optional mode 'arvore' uses debugger Accessibility.getFullAXTree flattened to role/name lines with element refs.
- browser_click({seletor | x,y}) and browser_type({seletor, texto, enviar?}): wc.debugger.attach('1.3') once per view; resolve the selector with Runtime.evaluate (getBoundingClientRect center, scrollIntoView), then Input.dispatchMouseEvent mousePressed/mouseReleased; type focuses the element and uses Input.insertText, then Input.dispatchKeyEvent Enter when enviar is true. Detach on view destroy.
- Every browser_* handler other than navigate first calls garanteSite(t, wc.getURL()), so a redirect or a page the person navigated to is gated too.
- garanteSite(t, url): host = new URL(url).hostname; allowed without a card if loopback, a host of a running launch.json server, in j.nav.sitesSessao, or in config.navegador.sites. Otherwise pedeAprovacao(t, { tipo:'permissao', ferramenta:'mcp__claudie__browser', entrada:{url}, motivo:'Claude quer abrir ' + host, temSempre:true, site: host }) which returns the same Promise as canUseTool; pendentes entry carries site. A deny returns isError text 'A pessoa negou o acesso a <host>'. Decision 'sim' adds host to sitesSessao only for this tool call's page (once); 'sempre' persists host in config.navegador.sites + salvarConfig(). Extract the canUseTool body (main.js:609-620) into pedeAprovacao so both share it (DRY).

Dev servers (<cwd>/.claude/launch.json, schema version + configurations[{name, runtimeExecutable, runtimeArgs, port, url, cwd, env}]):
- leLaunch(j): fs.readFileSync(path.join(j.cwd,'.claude','launch.json')), JSON.parse in try/catch, validate array and strings, return [] on any error; cwd from the entry resolved with dentroDaPasta(j.cwd, cfg.cwd) (main.js:53) falling back to j.cwd.
- servidorIniciar(j, nome): refuse if j.nav.procs has nome (reuse, no duplicate); if config.port is already accepting on 127.0.0.1 (net.connect probe) return an error naming the busy port instead of picking another (process-management rule); spawn(resolveExe(runtimeExecutable) wrapped in cmd.exe /c for .cmd/.bat, runtimeArgs, { cwd, env:{...process.env, ...cfg.env, PORT:String(port)}, windowsHide:true, detached: process.platform!=='win32' }) as terminalLiga does (main.js:1519); keep { p, port, url, log: ring buffer 200 lines } in j.nav.procs; poll the port (500 ms, 60 s cap) then enviarEvento(j,{tipo:'nav_servidor', nome, estado:'rodando', url}) and load url || http://localhost:port in the pane. exit/error handlers delete the entry and emit estado 'parado'.
- servidorParar(j, nome) and navegadorFecha(j, sincrono): matarArvore(p, sincrono), the function extracted from terminalMata (main.js:1506-1514). Called from the window 'closed' handler (main.js:839), before-quit (main.js:1832), and by destroying the view with view.webContents.close().
- IPC: nav_servidores (list launch.json names with running state) / nav_servidor_iniciar / nav_servidor_parar for the pane menu; MCP tools servidor_listar, servidor_iniciar, servidor_parar, servidor_logs for Claude (the start/stop ones are not in allowedTools so the normal card shows the command before it runs).

Wiring: main.js imports { iniciaNavegador } from './navegador.js' near line 18 and calls it with { J, janelas, enviarEvento, pendentes, config getter, salvarConfig, resolveExe, dentroDaPasta, matarArvore, ajustaImagem, pedeAprovacao, ipcMain, WebContentsView, session }. Changes to the existing link handlers: keep shell.openExternal at main.js:879 and 1674 (links in the chat open the system browser, as today); add to the pane's own link behavior only. Optionally a renderer link-click with Alt calls vivo.navAbrir. UI strings in Portuguese keys with src/renderer/i18n/parts/navegador.json (en, vi).

risks: A WebContentsView paints above all DOM: floating janelinhas, menus and the radial menu are hidden behind it inside its rect. Mitigation: dock it in its own grid column, and hide it (navArea(null)) while a modal or overlay is open. A true floating pane is not possible without a separate BrowserWindow.
The window uses offscreen when VIVO_GRAVAR is set (main.js:814), where child views may not render; the recording mode should skip the pane.

Prompt injection: page text returned by browser_read is untrusted data going to Claude. Per-site approval, no file: scheme and denied permissions limit it, but Claude reading a site and then typing into another still needs the same card on each host.

Spawning a runtimeExecutable from a project file runs project code. Claude-initiated starts go through the normal approval card; the person's own menu click is consent. Env values and cwd come from the file, so cwd is confined with dentroDaPasta and env is merged as strings only.

On Windows npm/pnpm are .cmd shims and spawn without a shell fails with EINVAL on recent Node; the wrapper must use cmd.exe /c with args quoted, and tree kill must be taskkill /T /F (npm spawns grandchildren).

Port-busy check races with the process starting; if the port is held by a stale server not tracked by Claudie it is reported to the person, not killed (process-management rules say do not kill what you did not start).
Debugger attach fails if devtools is open or already attached; keep one attach per view and re-attach on 'detach' event.
Each window has its own view and its own dev servers; the persist:preview partition is shared across windows (cookies shared, as in Claude Desktop 'keep cookies').
before-quit sync kill must run for every window including ones already closed; navegadorFecha has to be idempotent.

Should links clicked in the conversation open in the pane instead of the system browser (assumed: stay external unless Alt-click, to keep today's behavior)?
